module_summary: AXI read-channel register slice: AR channel uses a simple bubble-inserting register stage, R channel uses a skid buffer with output and temp registers steered by store enables.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave AR valid captured into the AR output register stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Slave AR ready from registered ready, high when AR output buffer empties.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Master AR valid driven by the AR stage valid register.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Downstream AR ready clearing the AR stage valid.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_araddr_reg
anchors.why: AR stage address register, representative of registered AR payload fields.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_arid_reg
anchors.why: AR stage ID register driving m_axi_arid.

anchors.name: genblk1.m_axi_arlen_reg
anchors.why: AR stage burst length register driving m_axi_arlen.

anchors.name: genblk1.store_axi_ar_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable capturing all AR input fields into AR output registers.

anchors.name: genblk1.s_axi_arready_early
anchors.why: Next-cycle AR ready computed from next valid state.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address captured by the AR register stage.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master R valid loaded into output or temp valid of skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master R ready from registered skid-buffer ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave R valid driven from skid buffer output valid register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Upstream R ready deciding output transfer versus temp storage.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: R output data register fed from m_axi_rdata or temp register.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rid_reg
anchors.why: R output ID register driving s_axi_rid.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rresp_reg
anchors.why: R output response register driving s_axi_rresp.

anchors.name: genblk2.s_axi_rlast_reg
anchors.why: R output last register driving s_axi_rlast.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data holding a beat while output is stalled.

anchors.name: genblk2.temp_s_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp-occupied flag gating rready and refilling output from temp.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable writing master R fields directly into output registers.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_input_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable writing master R fields into temp registers on stall.

anchors.name: genblk2.store_axi_r_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Selects temp registers instead of input as output register source.

anchors.name: genblk2.m_axi_rready_early
anchors.why: Next-cycle R ready from s_axi_rready and temp/output occupancy.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data loaded into output or temp data register.

groups.name: AR register stage
groups.description: Simple register slice for the AR channel; inserts bubble cycles.

groups.name: R skid output stage
groups.description: R channel output registers and ready logic of the skid buffer.

groups.name: R skid temp buffer
